title: On a spectral space a finitely presented sheaf of sets embeds into a finite product of pushed-forward finite constant sheaves on constructible closed subsets
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ and a set $S$ let $j_{U!}\underline S$ be the extension by the empty set [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty] of the sheaf $\underline S_U$ of locally constant maps to $S$ on $U$; for a closed $Z\subseteq X$ with inclusion $i_Z$ and a set $R$ let $(i_Z)_*\underline R_Z$ be the sheaf of sets $V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\cap Z\to R\}$ ($V\subseteq X$ open, restriction of maps). Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X$ for which there are integers $m,n\ge0$, quasi-compact open subsets $U_1,\dots,U_n,V_1,\dots,V_m\subseteq X$, finite sets $S_1,\dots,S_n,T_1,\dots,T_m$, two morphisms $\beta,\gamma:\coprod_{b=1}^mj_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a=1}^nj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ and a morphism $q:\coprod_{a=1}^nj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}\to\mathcal F$ such that $(\mathcal F,q)$ is a coequalizer of $\beta,\gamma$, coproducts and coequalizer taken in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then there are $k\ge0$, constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] closed subsets $Z_1,\dots,Z_k\subseteq X$, finite sets $R_1,\dots,R_k$ and a morphism of sheaves $\mathcal F\to\prod_{l=1}^k(i_{Z_l})_*\underline{R_l}_{Z_l}$ (product computed sectionwise) which is injective on sections over every open subset of $X$.
